Choose the right tool for you.

A lighter setup

Balances and history come from your selected JSON-RPC server. The wallet does not independently validate the blockchain; use Core if you want full-node verification.

Everyday payments

Use the desktop or Android app to receive CONN, send payments, and keep track of transactions.

Automatic Claims included

Participate in Pay-to-Connect from the wallet interface, with configurable connection limits. Keep your recovery phrase backed up and private.

Want to validate the blockchain yourself? Use ConnectCoin Core.
